entities.summary: The Airport Line  is a 6.5-kilometre (4.0 mi) private railway line in Japan, operated by Keikyū. The line runs between Keikyu Kamata and Haneda Airport Terminal 1·2 at Tokyo International Airport in Tokyo. Most trains continue beyond the Airport Line onto the Keikyū Main Line, operating northbound to Shinagawa in central Tokyo, with some services through-running onto the Toei Asakusa Line, or southbound to Yokohama, with select services continuing onward to Zushi-Hayama.
